source.source_title: iPod nano (Second Generation) - Technical Specifications - Apple Support (IE)
source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification page archived as original HTML on 2026-11-11; 12 source sections extracted. The first record section preserves model-identification evidence from Apple's separate identification page.
notes: Technical specifications are transcribed from the model-specific Apple technical-specification page; each added section carries its own source URL and archive path.
Model-identification evidence remains available from https://support.apple.com/en-ie/103823, archived at apple_remaining_extraction/technical_specs_html/ipod-index.html.

extraction.note: Official Apple iPod identification text retained. Explicit model numbers, introduction dates, capacity options and navigation interface extracted where present with source-section provenance. These are identification-page records, not full historical technical-specification sheets; no absent specs inferred.

sections.heading: iPod nano (2nd generation)
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Click Wheel
Capacity: 2, 4 and 8 GB
Model number and date introduced: A1199: September 2006
You can distinguish the iPod nano (2nd generation) from other models by:
Its smaller size
Its colours
The dock connector and headphone port are both located on the bottom of the device
The iPod nano (PRODUCT) RED Special Edition is an iPod nano (2nd generation) available in red and with a 4 GB or 8 GB drive capacity. With each iPod nano (PRODUCT) RED purchased, $10 from the sale goes directly to the Global Fund to fight AIDS in Africa.

sections.heading: Size and weight
sections.source_text: Size and weight: Height: 3.5 inches Width: 1.6 inches Depth: 0.26 inch Weight: 1.41 ounces

sections.heading: In the box
sections.source_text: In the box: iPod nano Earphones USB 2.0 cable Dock adapter Quick Start guide

sections.heading: Capacity
sections.source_text: Capacity: 2GB, 4GB, or 8GB flash drive (1) Holds up to 500 to 2,000 songs in 128-Kbps AAC format (2) Holds up to 25,000 iPod nano-viewable photos (3) Stores data via USB flash drive

sections.heading: Display
sections.source_text: Display: 1.5-inch (diagonal) liquid crystal display with blue-white LED backlight 176-by-132-pixel resolution, .168-mm dot pitch Support for display of multiple languages and characters simultaneously

sections.heading: Audio
sections.source_text: Audio: Skip-free playback Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz Audio formats supported: AAC (16 to 320 Kbps), Protected AAC (from iTunes Store), MP3 (16 to 320 Kbps), MP3 VBR, Audible (formats 2, 3, and 4), Apple Lossless, AIFF, and WAV User-configurable maximum volume limit

sections.heading: Headphones
sections.source_text: Headphones: Earphones Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz Impedance: 32 ohms

sections.heading: Mac system requirements
sections.source_text: Mac system requirements: Macintosh computer with USB 2.0 port Mac OS X v10.3.9 or later iTunes 7 or later (4)

sections.heading: Windows system requirements
sections.source_text: Windows system requirements: PC with USB 2.0 Windows 2000 with Service Pack 4 or later, or Windows XP Home or Professional with Service Pack 2 or later iTunes 7 or later (4)

sections.heading: Languages
sections.source_text: Languages: Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, and Turkish Additional language support for display of song, album, and artist information: Bulgarian, Croatian, Romanian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, and Ukrainian

sections.heading: Environmental requirements
sections.source_text: Environmental requirements: Operating temperature: 32° to 95° F (0° to 35° C) Nonoperating temperature: -4° to 113° F (-20° to 45° C) Relative humidity: 5% to 95% noncondensing Maximum operating altitude: 10,000 feet (3000 m)

sections.heading: Input and output
sections.source_text: Input and output: Dock connector 3.5-mm stereo headphone jack

sections.heading: Power and battery
sections.source_text: Power and battery: (5) Built-in rechargeable lithium ion battery Music playback time: Up to 24 hours when fully charged (3) Photo slideshow with music viewing time: Up to 5 hours when fully charged (3) Charging via USB or FireWire to computer system or power adapter (sold separately) Fast-charge time: about 1.5 hours (charges up to 80% of battery capacity) Full-charge time: about 3 hours 1GB = 1 billion bytes; actual formatted capacity less. Song capacity is based on 4 minutes per song and 128-Kbps AAC encoding; actual capacity varies by content. Photo capacity is based on iPod-viewable photos transferred from iTunes. iPod and iTunes are for legal or rightholder-authorized copying only. Don’t steal music. Rechargeable batteries have a limited number of charge cycles and may eventually need to be replaced. Battery life and number of charge cycles vary by use and settings. See www.apple.com/batteries for more information. Helpful? Yes No Character limit: 250 Maximum character limit is 250. Please don’t include any personal information in your comment. Submit Thanks for your feedback.
